summary: The same page watcher every six hours: one browser for all 12 pages, closed in a finally block, each screenshot overwriting the last.

must_not_flag.reason: One browser per run, closed in finally whatever happens, with a 15-second cap per page: at most about 3 minutes a run, four runs a day, about 6 browser hours a month, inside the 10 included. Each screenshot overwrites <page>/latest.png, so the bucket holds 12 objects.
